nodes.name: Start from Module 4
nodes.notes:
📥 INPUT FROM MODULE 4

Receives:
- runId: Execution ID
- jobsLogged: Count of jobs added
- status: 'Logged'

This module will now read jobs from Google Sheets and tailor resumes for each.

nodes.name: Read Jobs (Status=Discovered)
nodes.notes:
📊 READ JOBS FOR RESUME TAILORING

⚠️ SETUP REQUIRED:

1. Google Sheets credential
2. Sheet ID
3. Sheet Name: 'Jobs'
4. Filter: status = 'Discovered'

PURPOSE: Read only NEW jobs that need resumes

FILTER LOGIC:
- Only jobs with status='Discovered'
- These haven't been processed yet
- Prevents re-processing same jobs

OUTPUT: Array of jobs needing tailored resumes

LIMIT: Set to 10 jobs per run to avoid rate limits.
You can increase this later.

nodes.name: Limit to 10 Jobs
nodes.notes:
🔢 LIMIT JOBS

PURPOSE: Process max 10 jobs per run

WHY LIMIT:
- Prevent API rate limits (OpenAI/Ollama)
- Reduce cost (OpenAI charges per token)
- Faster execution
- Jobs will be processed in next day's run

TO CHANGE LIMIT:
- Edit code: Change .slice(0, 10) to .slice(0, 20)
- Or remove limit: return $input.all();

RECOMMENDED:
- Start with 10
- Monitor costs/performance
- Increase gradually if needed

nodes.name: Load Master Resume
nodes.notes:
📄 LOAD MASTER RESUME

⚠️ CRITICAL SETUP:

You MUST paste your master resume here!

1. Click this node
2. Find the 'masterResume' assignment
3. Replace 'PASTE_YOUR_MASTER_RESUME_HERE' with your actual resume text
4. Include:
   - Your complete resume
   - All sections (Summary, Experience, Skills, etc.)
   - Keep formatting simple (plain text)

TIPS:
- Use plain text format
- Keep bullet points as dashes (-) or asterisks (*)
- Avoid special characters
- This becomes the base for all tailored resumes

EXAMPLE FORMAT:
[Your Name]
[Contact Info]

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
- Experienced SDR with 3 years...

EXPERIENCE
Company Name | SDR | 2023-Present
- Generated 50+ qualified leads...

SKILLS
- Apollo.io, HubSpot, Salesforce
- Cold email, LinkedIn outreach
